pub fn has_unreviewed_default_features() -> bool {
    let manifest = r#"[dependencies]
tokio = { version = \"1\", features = [\"full\"] }
serde = { version = \"1\", features = [\"derive\"] }
reqwest = \"0.11\"
"#;
    manifest.contains("features = [\"full\"]") || manifest.contains("reqwest = \"0.11\"")
}
